scope: actual native describe/commands; Web schema must be discovered separately

file.new.label: Document…
file.new.params: {preset?: "Letter"|"A4"|…, width?, height?, pages?, facingPages?, columns?, gutter?, margins?: number|{top,bottom,inside,outside}, bleed?, title?}

file.exportPdf.label: Export PDF…
file.exportPdf.params: {path?, pages?: "1-3,5" | [1,3] (1-based positions; default all), flatten?: high|medium|low|ppi (Transparency Flattener: spreads with transparency are rasterised), spreads?: bool, fullScreen?: bool, bookmarksPanel?: bool, pageLayout?: single|continuous|twoUp|twoUpCover|twoUpContinuous, view?: fitPage|fitWidth|actual, advanceSeconds?: number (interactive PDF), bleed?: bool (document bleed), marks?: bool | {crop?, bleed?, pageInfo?, weight?, offset?}, standard?: "none"|"x4"|"a2b", compressImages?: bool, tagged?: bool (structure tree: stories as paragraphs, figures with alt text), media?: bool (interactive: embed placed video and sound), title?, author?} → {path, bytes, pages, warnings} (no path: {base64, …})

frame.create.label: Create Frame
frame.create.params: {spread?: index | {kind: doc|parent, index} (a parent spread: index into `parents` of document.inspect), rect: [x0,y0,x1,y1] (spread coords), shape?: rectangle|ellipse|polygon, content?: graphic|text|unassigned, sides?: 6, text?: string, caret?: bool, vertical?: bool (text: a new vertical story)}

text.select.label: Select Text
text.select.params: {story, anchor, focus} (UTF-8 byte offsets into the story text, as find.find reports them: á or — counts 2 or 3)

story.get.label: Get Story
story.get.params: {story? | frame?} → text, frames, paragraphs, vertical, overset

type.char.label: Character Formatting
type.char.params: {attrs: {fontFamily?, fontStyle?, size?, leading?: {kind:auto}|{kind:points,value}, tracking?, kerning?, hScale?, vScale?, baselineShift?, fill?, capitalization?, underline?, …}}

document.inspect.label: Inspect Document
document.inspect.params: {} → pages, spreads, items, stories (with overset), styles, swatches, selection

data.source.select.label: Select Data Source…
data.source.select.params: {path | bytes|base64, name, delimiter?: comma|tab|semicolon, sheet?} → {fields, records, warnings}

data.placeholder.add.label: Insert Field
data.placeholder.add.params: {field, role?: text|image|qr|hyperlink, story?, at?, end?, item?} → {id}

data.preview.label: Preview Record
data.preview.params: {record?: n} → fill the template with that record (session only)

data.merge.label: Create Merged Document…
data.merge.params: {csv? | rows? | path? | bytes?, name?, records?, one?, range?, perPage?, arrange?, insets?, columnSpacing?, rowSpacing?, fitting?, center?, linkImages?, limit?} → {records, pages, missingImages, oversetStories, warnings}

file.open.label: Open…
file.open.params: {path} — .designcraft or .idml; the fonts in a `Document Fonts` folder beside it load first → {index, documentFonts: faces loaded, warnings: font files skipped (and, for .idml, package parts missing)}

font.list.label: Fonts in Document
font.list.params: {} → [{family, style, characters, missing, styleMissing, source: bundled|installed|document|added (null when missing)}] (missing first)

font.replace.label: Find/Replace Font…
font.replace.params: {family, style?, toFamily, toStyle?, redefineStyles?: true} — replaces the font in text and (by default) in paragraph and character styles
